end.parentNote: Pari practised linking non-metals with everyday uses, including oxygen for respiration, nitrogen in chip packets, carbon in pencils, iodine as a solid, and chlorine for water treatment. They first mixed up plant respiration and photosynthesis, then corrected this by explaining that plants respire all the time and photosynthesise during the day. At home, ask Pari to sort non-metals into solid, liquid, and gas groups and match each with one use.
